visual_decision: Retain isolated first-form source as a working baseline, refuse concept-body appearance qualification: directional changes visible but modest.

findings.explanation: Matched actual originals show fuller waist/middle, hips/seat and upper limbs, while preserving a strongly narrowed waist and comparatively lean limbs; the clothed concept shows a substantially broader middle/upper-limb mass. Clothing and pose prevent exact anatomy measurement.
alternatives: Fresh explicit broader body recipe with complete refit/one matched view set: advances silhouette but needs new complete native validation.
Keep exact form and start wardrobe/face/hair: progresses recognition but risks tailoring to an unresolved body form.

findings.explanation: Head crop includes crown/ears/chin; source face and pale skin/stubble remain generic and lack the concept curls/complexion/facial mass. Shoulders extend outside the head crop by design; no clipped crown/ear observed.
alternatives: Separate face/skin/curl design contract after body decision: retains consistent identity work but delays likeness.
Parallel conceptual facial brief without new geometry: clarifies landmarks while body work proceeds, but cannot qualify appearance.

limits: No concept identity, material, hairstyle, wardrobe, expression, motion, complete-influence runtime, coupled fit or AAA acceptance. All source images preserved, no retune/retry.
